description: Open CASCADE's own STEP of boolean/fuse-end-disc-tangent-to-wall (a vertical cylinder fused with a horizontal one whose end disc touches its wall along a ruling), read as a part. Its file writes two VERTEX_POINTs at (6, 0, 2), where the section ellipse touches the horizontal wall's end rim, where its shape has one: the vertical wall's loop arrives there on the ellipse at #80 and leaves on the seam at #116. Its own reader heals them into one; Arris's reader keeps a vertex per VERTEX_POINT, so the loop is open at that junction and the solid is refused: '#15: loop 0 of f0 is open at junction 2' (the retired tangency-faults plan, found by the read-back stage; docs/BACKLOG.md, the reader's coincident VERTEX_POINTs). The desired assertion: it reads, with one vertex at the touch, and matches Open CASCADE's reading.

analytic.occt_odd_euler: Open CASCADE carries the touching ruling as an edge of four faces, so its shape has an odd Euler characteristic
